action: Name accountable owner, qualified reviewer and operational lead
proceed_condition: Each approval and rollback decision has a named owner
stop_or_revise_condition: Responsibility is implicit or unavailable

action: Map one workflow from trigger to final sign-off
proceed_condition: Inputs, hand-offs, exceptions, outputs and judgement points are visible
stop_or_revise_condition: Scope remains 'use AI' rather than a defined workflow

action: Collect a four-week workflow baseline
proceed_condition: Volume, time, review, corrections, exceptions and incidents have denominators
stop_or_revise_condition: No stable comparator exists

action: Classify personal, payroll, tax, bank and client-confidential data
proceed_condition: Permitted data and environments are approved
stop_or_revise_condition: Sensitive data would enter an unapproved environment

action: Choose Use, Integrate, Automate, Configure or no adoption
proceed_condition: Task-system fit and consequence justify the choice
stop_or_revise_condition: Pathway is selected because a vendor offers it

action: Pre-register measures, cost boundary and stop rules
proceed_condition: Quality, benefit, risk and cost rules are written before results
stop_or_revise_condition: Thresholds are chosen after seeing pilot results

action: Approve one enterprise-grade standalone assistant
proceed_condition: Terms, retention, access and training use are acceptable
stop_or_revise_condition: Only uncontrolled consumer access is available

action: Document prohibited data and permitted task types
proceed_condition: Users can distinguish permitted and prohibited inputs
stop_or_revise_condition: Client data rules are ambiguous

action: Create bounded prompt templates with sources and caveats
proceed_condition: Output format and source requirements are explicit
stop_or_revise_condition: Prompt permits professional conclusions without evidence

action: Prepare 20 known tasks and edge cases
proceed_condition: Reference answers and scoring are available
stop_or_revise_condition: No accepted comparator exists

action: Run known tasks with two users and no identifiable client data
proceed_condition: Testing represents intended users and task
stop_or_revise_condition: Test uses uncontrolled live client records

action: Score support, missing caveats, confidentiality and correction time
proceed_condition: Required quality and refusal behaviour pass
stop_or_revise_condition: Unsupported output or material omission fails the rule

action: Permit limited live use for approved internal tasks
proceed_condition: Named users follow source-check and approval rules
stop_or_revise_condition: Outputs leave the firm without qualified review

action: Review corrections, usage and incidents after four weeks
proceed_condition: Benefit remains after review and correction effort
stop_or_revise_condition: Risk or total effort exceeds the accepted boundary

action: Select one measured ledger or close bottleneck
proceed_condition: Outcome is measurable and workflow-specific
stop_or_revise_condition: Objective is a generic AI implementation

action: Review supplier data flows, retention, access, logs, export and exit
proceed_condition: Material supplier questions are resolved
stop_or_revise_condition: Data route, logging or exit remains unacceptable

action: Construct historical known cases including unusual items
proceed_condition: Cases cover routine and failure-prone work
stop_or_revise_condition: Only easy demonstrations are tested

action: Compare suggestions, confidence, exceptions and review time
proceed_condition: Quality and exception behaviour meet the pre-registered rule
stop_or_revise_condition: Material error or unexplained result occurs

action: Run two close cycles without relying on AI output
proceed_condition: Every disagreement is reviewed and logged
stop_or_revise_condition: Output cannot be reconstructed or overridden

action: Pilot with 10 low-complexity illustrative clients
proceed_condition: Client segment and reviewer capacity are appropriate
stop_or_revise_condition: Client complexity or risk exceeds pilot boundary

action: Route low-confidence, unusual and high-value items to reviewer
proceed_condition: Thresholds capture known failure cases
stop_or_revise_condition: Exceptions bypass review

action: Prohibit automatic material postings and retain overrides
proceed_condition: Original, suggestion, reviewer and reason are retained
stop_or_revise_condition: Material posting can occur without approval

action: Compare total effort, quality and full cost after two live cycles
proceed_condition: Measured benefit exceeds full cost with quality maintained
stop_or_revise_condition: Benefit disappears after correction/review or controls fail

action: Draw trigger-data-decision-action-review-log flow
proceed_condition: Every permitted action and reviewer is visible
stop_or_revise_condition: Autonomous scope is ambiguous

action: Use deterministic rules where rules are sufficient
proceed_condition: AI is limited to genuinely uncertain steps
stop_or_revise_condition: AI is added to a stable deterministic rule without need

action: Make first release read-only or draft-only
proceed_condition: No external message or ledger action can occur
stop_or_revise_condition: Tool can act beyond the approved boundary

action: Test missing, wrong-client, conflict, duplicate, unusual and outage cases
proceed_condition: Failures route safely to named staff
stop_or_revise_condition: Failure creates an unlogged or external action

action: Compare proposed automated actions with staff decisions
proceed_condition: False and missed actions meet the rule
stop_or_revise_condition: Staff cannot explain rejected or accepted actions

action: Require approval before client communication or ledger posting
proceed_condition: Named approval is technically enforced
stop_or_revise_condition: Approval can be bypassed

action: Monitor rejected actions, corrections, incidents and review displacement
proceed_condition: Logging is complete and reviewed
stop_or_revise_condition: Logging fails or a material incident occurs

action: Pause, rollback and re-authorise after material change
proceed_condition: Manual fallback works and changes are reassessed
stop_or_revise_condition: Rollback is unavailable or untested

action: Define the knowledge question and authorised users
proceed_condition: Scope is an internal retrieval problem
stop_or_revise_condition: Plan begins by uploading all files

action: Inventory documents, owners, versions, access and expiry
proceed_condition: Authoritative current documents are identified
stop_or_revise_condition: Obsolete or ownerless documents remain

action: Remove duplicates and restrict corpus to approved material
proceed_condition: Each document has authority and access metadata
stop_or_revise_condition: Conflicting sources cannot be resolved

action: Require document and section citations in every answer
proceed_condition: Users can verify every supported claim
stop_or_revise_condition: Answers are fluent but untraceable

action: Build 30 direct, ambiguous, conflicting, outdated and no-answer tests
proceed_condition: Test set covers refusal and conflict behaviour
stop_or_revise_condition: Only direct-answer examples are tested

action: Score support, citation, completeness, refusal and review time
proceed_condition: Required performance and refusal rules pass
stop_or_revise_condition: Unsupported answer or incorrect citation fails the rule

action: Pilot on internal procedures without client files
proceed_condition: Access controls and source checking operate
stop_or_revise_condition: Client data enter before assurance is complete

action: Add refresh, deletion, access review and incident processes
proceed_condition: Corpus and permissions remain current
stop_or_revise_condition: Updates or deletions cannot be propagated

action: Reject custom model training unless a separate capability case passes
proceed_condition: Skills, cost, security and assurance are proportionate
stop_or_revise_condition: Build is chosen only for novelty or prestige
